decision: F0a implementation started on feature/foundation from origin/main 7243da8; pnpm install and shared packages built; baseline suite on igcse_foundation_test
why: prove the starting point before changing anything

decision: dev databases igcse_foundation_dev and igcse_foundation_backfill_dev created from igcse_template_dev (34 migrations applied, 5 users: one student at grade 12, 3 sessions, 8 registrations)
why: the backfill is proven on a fresh copy before and after the migration

decision: the cohort is stored on user.cohort_year (start year of the academic year the student starts grade 10); user.grade is dropped (migration 0036) so type-checking finds every reader; the grade is a pure function in @repo/validations (academic-year.ts) and three SQL functions (migration 0035: school_academic_year_start, school_grade, school_series_academic_year_start) exported as Drizzle helpers from @repo/db (academic.ts)
why: FEATURES_PLAN F0a: the grade changes once a year at the end of the June session; a function for code and a SQL expression for the queries that filter on grade

decision: backfill rules: a stored grade G becomes cohort = (academic year of the migration) - (G - 10); a student with no grade is graduated when an audit row set their grade to null (graduated in that row's academic year: cohort = that year - 3) or when they have any registration (every old path required a grade; graduated as of the migration), otherwise unknown (cohort null, refused registration as a null grade was); every window's series year is the year in its name, else the first time its series month comes on or after its close in Cairo; files take the purpose of their route
why: the plan asks that graduated and unknown students be told apart; graduation was stored as grade=null (grade.services.ts GRADE-003), which a student who never finished sign-up also looks like

decision: backfill proven on two fresh copies of igcse_template_dev: igcse_foundation_backfill_dev (the dev data as is: 1 student at grade 12, 3 windows) and igcse_foundation_backfill_rich_dev (plus synthetic rows for every branch: grades 10 and 11, graduated by an audit row of 15 Jan 2026, graduated with a registration only, never graded, an October and a January window without a year in the name, an avatar and a document file). Before: stored grades and windows snapshotted into side tables; after: 0 mismatches, 0 non-students with a cohort, 0 windows without a series; the audit-row graduate got cohort 2022 (grade 14 today), the registration-only graduate 2023 (grade 13), the unknown student null; June 2027 (UI check) got 2027 from its name, the October window 2026, the January window 2027 from its close; files avatar->avatar, document->document; school_academic_year_start gives 2026 at 2027-06-30T20:30Z and 2027 at 22:30Z
why: the plan asks for the backfill on a copy of dev data with before and after counts

decision: 01-desk "onboards a walk-in family": old `select role, grade ... toMatchObject({ grade: 11 })`; new `select role, cohort_year, school_grade(cohort_year, school_academic_year_start(now())) as grade ...` expecting cohort_year = this academic year - 1 and grade 11
why: the grade column is dropped (F0a): the desk still enters "grade 11" and the test now proves it is stored as the cohort and read back as grade 11 today; not a money assertion

decision: 06-auth-surface sign-up, update-user and profile-update privilege tests: old asserted grade stays null / 11 after injecting `grade`; new inject `grade`, `cohortYear` and `leftOn` and assert cohort_year and left_on stay null (parent) or unchanged at this year - 1 (student)
why: the stored field is now the cohort; the tests keep their intent (no client can set its own standing) and also try the new field names; security, not money

decision: 08b ST-04 "a student who graduates with a checkout open": old trigger PUT /v1/grade/:id {newGrade:null} and notice title "Payment closed: student graduated"; new trigger POST /v1/students/:id/leave {withdrawn} and notice title "Payment closed" with a body naming the withdrawal. Money outcomes kept word for word (registration expired, payment failed, escrow back to 1500, PAYMENT_FAILED audited, family told) and added: the REGISTRATION_EXPIRED row says reason ineligible, detail withdrawn
why: pre-authorised (FEATURES_PLAN.md section 5): graduation is no longer an event, so its trigger becomes a withdrawal; the reviewer checks each

decision: 08b ST-04 "a checkout whose transfer is being checked keeps its registration through graduation": old trigger manual graduation; new trigger a transfer (leaving) with the same assertions (registration pending_payment, payment pending_verification), extended: finance then rejects the transfer and the registration expires and cannot be checked out again (SO-7 closed)
why: pre-authorised trigger change; SO-7 said a kept registration whose transfer is rejected stays payable because checkout did not check graduation; checkout and the rejection now ask mayRegisterFor

decision: 09 "every expired registration has exactly one audit row saying why": old known reasons (session_closed, entry_deadline, graduated, payment_closed, preregistration_unfunded_at_deadline); new adds ineligible, and requires an ineligible row to name a known cause in detail (withdrawn, transferred, cohort_corrected, graduate_retakes_off, series_corrected, exception_revoked)
why: CLAUDE.md: a new money movement gets its rule in 09; the eligibility clean-up is a new system expiry. The rule is stricter for the new reason, unchanged for the old ones. Flagged for the lead: 09 is not in the pre-authorised list

decision: closePaymentsOfGraduatedStudents and notifyPaymentClosedAtGraduation deleted; closePaymentsOfExpiredRegistrations (payment.services.ts) replaces them for every eligibility change, with a notice naming the cause (notifyPaymentClosedIneligible)
why: FEATURES_PLAN F0a: reused or replaced, not deleted, until the scenarios show nothing calls it. 08e (withdrawn, cohort moved back, A-12 off, series corrected, exception revoked) and 08b ST-04 passed on the replacement; grep over apps/api/src, apps/api/test, apps/web/app and packages found only the function, its own import and its own notice
